subject: SOC2 evidence workshop: SSO / KMS / audit logs — coordinating times
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@helixhealth.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 evidence review — request + proposed windows

Hi Diego / Mina / Grace,

Thanks again for the quick intake last week. Helix Health is moving toward a pre-assessment for SOC 2 and we need a technical evidence workshop to walk our security team through: SSO integration, KMS/encryption model, and audit log extraction and retention.

Can your team do a 60–90 minute deep-dive sometime next week? Our preferred windows (PST):
- Wed 2026-09-23 10:00–11:30
- Thu 2026-09-24 13:00–14:30
- Fri 2026-09-25 08:30–10:00

I've attached our initial evidence request and a rough questionnaire (SOC2_evidence_request_helix_v1.pdf). Please confirm who from Redwood will present each area and whether those windows work.

Thanks,
Sara
Head of Compliance
Helix Health

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_request_helix_v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@helixhealth.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence review — request + proposed windows

Sara — thanks for the note and the attachment. We can run a focused session. Quick responses:

- Availability: Wed 9/23 10:00–11:30 PST works best for us. If you need the later slot on 9/24 we can also stretch to 90 mins.
- Proposed presenters / owners from Redwood:
  - Mina Haddad — SSO, identity mapping, SAML/OIDC metadata and test accounts
  - Grace O'Connor — audit logs, log retention policy, ELT/export examples
  - Diego Fernandez — deployment topology, KMS integration and encryption-at-rest details

Can you confirm the attendee list on your side (security engineer(s), compliance manager, procurement if needed)? Also, please indicate if you require us to provide sample artifacts ahead of time (SAML metadata, sample audit log exports, KMS key policy snippets). If so, we will upload to a shared drive link.

Two small notes: our SSO tech lead (Mina) is in CET in the mornings — she'll be on this call but might join slightly late if we pick very early PST times. We'll include timezone conversions in the invite.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@helixhealth.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@helixhealth.io>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence review — request + proposed windows

Thanks Diego — attendee list from our side: Alicia Ramos (Compliance Manager), Tom Bishop (Security Engineer), and me. Alicia will own confirmation and follow-ups.

Agenda we'd like to cover (60–90 min):
1) High-level architecture + deployment topology (10 min)
2) SSO (SAML/OIDC) integration details and test plan (20 min)
3) KMS and key management model — HSM vs. cloud KMS, key rotation cadence (15 min)
4) Audit logs — what we can export, retention windows, and how to provide logs for auditors (20 min)
5) Q&A / next steps (10–15 min)

We do need a handful of artifacts uploaded before the meeting so our team can review:
- SAML metadata / IdP SP configuration (if you have a sample)
- Sample audit log exports (last 30 days, redacted)
- KMS key policy snippets and rotation schedule

I'll attach our artifact matrix (artifact_matrix.xlsx) but if you can confirm what you'll upload and where (Drive link or secure SFTP) that would be great.

Sara

Attachments: artifact_matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@helixhealth.io>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 07:22:00 +0200
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence review — request + proposed windows

Hi Sara — happy to run SSO and walk through test metadata. Proposed internal agenda (we'll align to your bullets):

- 0–10: Intro + architecture (Diego)
- 10–30: SSO deep-dive (Mina) — SAML/AuthN flow diagrams, IdP/SP sample metadata, dev/test accounts, automated test plan
- 30–45: KMS/encryption (Diego) — key hierarchy, envelope encryption, rotation policy (we'll bring key policy snippets)
- 45–65: Audit logs (Grace) — what logs are captured at each layer (API, runtime, network), retention defaults, export format (JSON/CSV), redaction approach
- 65–80: Q&A / next steps

Owners: Mina (SSO, test plan), Diego (KMS / topology), Grace (audit logs + exports).

We can provide the following artifacts before the call: sample SAML metadata, a 7-day redacted audit log export (JSON), and excerpts of KMS policies. Prefer to upload to a Google Drive folder with view-only links — but if you require SFTP let us know.

Two requests on our side: please include any auditor contact or scope notes (so we can prepare the exact formats) and let us know whether you need any attestation language in advance.

Thanks — Mina
Technical Lead, Identity & Security Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@helixhealth.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence review — request + proposed windows

Appreciate the quick coordination. One additional ask: procurement is tracking contract redlines and will want a short follow-up call focused on evidence retention SLAs and responsibilities. Can we add a 30-minute procurement touchpoint after the technical workshop? Tom (security) will join the technical session and Alicia will join both.

Also: could you confirm if you are able to export full audit logs (fields: timestamp, request_id, user_id, action, resource, response_code) for an auditor in CSV/JSON and whether there are any PII fields we would need to redact? We'll share the scope.

Alicia Ramos
Compliance Manager
Helix Health
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@helixhealth.io>, Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@helixhealth.io>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, procurement@helixhealth.io
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence review — request + proposed windows

All — thanks, confirmed. I've scheduled the technical workshop for Wed 2026-09-23 10:00–11:30 PST (90 minutes) and added a 30-minute procurement follow-up on Thu 2026-09-24 11:00–11:30 PST to cover retention SLAs and contract items. Calendar invite attached.

What we'll upload before the workshop (Drive links will be shared by EOD Monday):
- sample_saml_metadata.xml
- audit_logs_redacted_7days.json (redacted, last 7 days)
- kms_policy_snippets.txt
- a one-page architecture diagram (deployment_topology.pdf)

Attachments: calendar.ics (text/calendar), sample_export_instructions.md (text/markdown)

Notes:
- Timezones: 10:00 PST = 18:00 CET (Mina may join at 18:05 CET).
- If Helix needs the logs in a particular CSV schema for auditors, please send the schema; otherwise we'll provide JSON + CSV conversion.
- Security: artifacts will be view-only links. If you need encrypted transfer, we can provision SFTP.

See you all on the 23rd — I'll upload the Drive folder link once the files are in place.

Diego
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
